description: QUOPS capability (arXiv:2609.12146) for physical qubits, STAR, and full FT on the study's nearest-neighbor array.

test.note: Declared: 100 mirror circuits x 100 shots, each about twice the forward size (10^4 executions). The paper prescribes no count; Willow used 2x10^5, H2 and Helios 2-4x10^3 (docs/QUOPS_SPEC.md). With Willow's count, FT capability above s~10^7 falls by roughly an order of magnitude because slow logical shots then need many replicas.

routing.note: Measured nearest-neighbor routing of QUOPS layers (docs/QUOPS_ROUTING.md): fused two-qubit gates and depth per layer for Cirq RouteCQC and a constructive sorting network; the lower-loss router is used at each width.

surgery.note: A layer of disjoint long-range CNOTs by lattice surgery in the fast block, assumed congestion-free: two code clocks.

ft.better_source_note: Declared sensitivity: cultivated states at 2e-11 instead of 2e-9, with the same footprint and timing, to show which FT features are set by source quality.
ft.source_menu_note: Set ft.source_menu = 'litinski' to add the published factories of Litinski (2019) at matching p, read from the table in litinski_factories (used by python/quops_sensitivity.py).

scope: Analytical model. NISQ routing uses the measured laws of docs/QUOPS_ROUTING.md; lattice-surgery timing is a declared model. Polarization uses the embedded process-infidelity product validated in docs/QUOPS_POLARIZATION.md; synthesis error is charged quadratically as in the paper; mirror-test shots follow Willow's protocol. The STAR channel is the Hubbard study's restricted generator-fault instrument at the circuit's uniformly random angles.
polarization: Embedded process-infidelity product (docs/QUOPS_POLARIZATION.md): exact to 0.2% on w=2-8.
noise: SD6 uniform circuit noise: DEPOLARIZE2(p) per two-qubit gate, DEPOLARIZE1(p) per one-qubit gate and per idle 10 ns slot; process infidelity equals the total Pauli error probability.
connectivity_note: All-to-all hardware (connectivity isolated; same 240 ns clock): transversal CNOTs (half the Clifford clocks), one tile per logical qubit (no routing space), 2 tiles per injection lane, no charge per T port, T-state transfer by transversal teleportation (d rounds); Pinnacle arm from python/pinnacle.py.
